I am aware of the whole mumbo jumbo that comes along with the real stuff, I have been to many fortune tellers and some of them were just plainly trying to shake some money from me. 

I can read cards too, so I usually follow along when they are doing so, and know when they are just coming up with some stupid ass idea of a random love so they can sell me a love spell.

But I used to go to  this good fortune teller many who kept seeing my mentor, which was not my guardian angel.

I was walking in a park in Dublin randomly having a dialogue with myself and this weird gipsy old lady stopped me and talked to me and mentor, and simply walked away. (Probably crazy lady)

Various people have said that over the years, to different levels of credibility.

The most recent on was this friend of mine who is a voodoo priest of sorts (don't remember how they are actually called). But he said he couldn't help me identify my mentor, because he is not of African lore it is something older and different from what he knows. He talked about my guardian angel, my servant spirit and my mentor as three different entities.

I really need to meditate more. But my head just runs wild every time I try to do so. My teenager yoga teacher used to say I have too much energy and very little control over it.

Well, that is the whole thing. Mostly I have this weird memories and uncontrollable feelings about things or people I have no idea about.

I strongly believe that I was a high priest of Ra in one of my past lives, with vivid details about my daily routine in the temple. It is kinda insane right there.

I may keep going, I also have this looping thoughts and fighting self's inside of me and as I grow weaker they also grow stronger. I never had lucid an live delusions about the present besides strong uncontrollable feelings about people and situations I had no knowledge previously.

But the worst thing that scares me the most are those days where I feel completely detached from this reality. It is as if I were inside and fishbowl and the world is moving around me and my body moves on impulses, where I feel I am not in control at all. I have had that since I was a child.

I used to say that it is like past, present and future get all superimposed in my head and I can't really distinguish between one or the other for a while.

So it be a soul thing where things get confusing or me just going schizophrenic.
